title: Agentic Apps on Microsoft Fabric: Mind-Blowing Interactive Experiences
description:
Imagine turning your Microsoft Fabric semantic models into stunning, interactive apps in minutes. Less Clicking More Building. Discover the brand-new agentic development experience that lets you choose the agents to build reporting. No deep coding, no complex frameworks, just point, describe, and watch agents orchestrate everything. Visuals, custom navigation, writeback, you can have it all directly on your Fabric assets. Think no-holds-barred analytics experiences.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
